opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK only; must undertake internationally competitive research; university Development Office should coordinate applications
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research; sometimes for access/research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; fully accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme; hold a permanent collection of national significance
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; sites listed Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument (England & Wales), Category A/B/Scheduled (Scotland), Grade A/B+/Scheduled (NI); open and accessible to the public
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for places providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants to support special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, helping pupils develop skills for employment or independent living. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; fully accredited under Archive Service Accreditation Scheme; hold a permanent collection of national significance
opportunities.summary: Grants towards collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; focused on professional performance with performing arts as the vast majority of activities
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK; displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance; fully accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education/learning spaces. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants to capital projects which help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two-stage application, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for places of worship

amount.raw: Not stated on page; delivered through National Churches Trust (fabric repair grants for churches) and historic buildings & landscapes programme

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Places of worship of outstanding historic and architectural significance; fabric repair grants for churches administered by the National Churches Trust; places of worship of other faiths via historic buildings & landscapes programme; cathedrals can apply through the latter
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation and restoration work on places of worship of outstanding historic and architectural significance, delivered through two routes: fabric repair grants for churches (administered by the National Churches Trust) and the historic buildings & landscapes programme for other faiths and cathedrals.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; maximum grant amount £100,000; usual range £15,000–£50,000 (equipment), £15,000–£100,000 (new build/refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK; at least two years of exam results; Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating of 'Good' or above; project must cost at least £25,000
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects (new build, refurbishment or technical equipment) that help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of specialist subjects at GCSE and A-Level. 2026 round is closed; next round dates to be shared in spring 2027.
